plugins.readme_text:
# 📄 Markdown Studio for DeepSeek Harness **在 DSH 原生右侧文件预览中，把 Markdown 里的 Mermaid 图表、数学公式、代码高亮一次看全。** 渲染引擎随插件内置，**完全离线可用** · 无需改动你的文档 · 停用即恢复官方渲染器 [![CI](https://github.com/BioAIEvolu/dsh-md-studio/actions/workflows/ci.yml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/BioAIEvolu/dsh-md-studio/actions/workflows/ci.yml) [![npm](https://img.shields.io/npm/v/dsh-md-studio)](https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-md-studio) [![GitHub release](https://img.shields.io/github/v/release/BioAIEvolu/dsh-md-studio)](https://github.com/BioAIEvolu/dsh-md-studio/releases) [![License: MIT](https://img.shields.io/badge/License-MIT-yellow.svg)](LICENSE) [![DSH](https://img.shields.io/badge/DeepSeek%20Harness-0.2.0--rc.2-blue)](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) [![English](https://img.shields.io/badge/docs-English-green)](README.en.md) [同一份 Mermaid 代码块：官方预览 vs Markdown Studio](docs/images/before-after.png)
--- ## 为什么需要它 DeepSeek Harness 的右侧文件预览很好用，但 **Mermaid 代码块只会显示为一堆源码**——架构图、时序图、流程图全都要靠想象。外部方案要么需要开独立面板、要么依赖 CDN 联网。 **Markdown Studio 直接接管原生预览的 Markdown 渲染器**：文件读取、权限校验、刷新、标签页这些全部保留 DSH 原生行为，只有"画"的部分被增强。渲染引擎（Mermaid / markdown-it / KaTeX / highlight.js / DOMPurify）**随插件打包**，断网也能看图。 | 官方预览 | Markdown Studio | |---|---| | `​```mermaid` 显示为代码块 | 就地渲染为 SVG 图 + 工具栏 | | 长文档来回滚动 | 图文混排，所见即所得 | ## ✨ 特性 - **📈 对话内 + 文档预览双渲染**：聊天消息里的 Mermaid 块与右侧打开的 Markdown 文档，用同一套管线就地渲染成 SVG 图 - **📈 Mermaid 图表**：流程图、时序图、甘特图、饼图等 Mermaid 11 全系图型；每张图带 **图形/源码切换 · 全屏（缩放/拖拽）· 下载 SVG** 工具栏；深浅主题自动重绘 - **🩹 语法自动修复**：真实文档里最常见的 `W2[Codex / Claude Code (ACP)]` 这类"标签含英文括号"语法错误，**自动修复后照常渲染**，并在徽章标注"已自动修复"——不用改你的文档 - **📐 KaTeX 数学公式**：行内 `$...$` 与块级 `$$...$$`（文档预览） - **📝 完整 GFM**：表格、任务列表、脚注、删除线、标题锚点跳转 - **🎨 代码高亮**：highlight.js 常用语言集 - **🖼️ 本地图片**：相对路径按文档目录解析，经 DSH 原生鉴权接口读取 - **📴 完全离线**：渲染零网络请求（有自动化测试断言兜底）；作者写在文档里的远程图片仍按原 URL 加载 - **🛡️ 安全**：DOMPurify 双重净化（文档 HTML + 图表 SVG），禁执行脚本；Mermaid `strict` 模式 ## 📸 截图 | 深色主题 | | |---|---| | ![深色主题完整渲染](docs/images/demo-dark.png) | ![浅色主题完整渲染](docs/images/demo-light.png) | | 深色 | 浅色 | ## 🚀 安装 > 需要 DeepSeek Harness `0.2.0-rc.2+`（客户端插槽 API 依赖，见 [兼容性](#️-兼容性)） **方式一 · 可视化插件市场（dshmarket）** 在 DSH 设置 → 插件 → 市场中搜索 `dsh-md-studio`。 **方式二 · 命令行（GitHub）** ```sh dsh plugin --profile desktop add github:BioAIEvolu/dsh-md-studio ``` **方式三 · 命令行（npm，发布后可用）** ```sh dsh plugin --profile desktop add dsh-md-studio ``` 安装后重启 DSH Desktop，在右侧打开任意 `.md` 文件即可。 ## 📖 使用 打开 Markdown 文件后： - 文档顶部出现 **Markdown Studio** 标识与 **查看源码** 按钮（整篇源码/渲染视图切换） - 每个 Mermaid 图表自带工具栏：**图形 / 源码 / 全屏 / 下载 SVG** - 全屏模式支持滚轮缩放、拖拽平移、一键适应 - 语法错误的图表保留源码并给出原因，**不影响文档里其他图表** - 不想用了？在插件管理中停用，官方渲染器原样恢复 试试仓库里的 [docs/demo.md](docs/demo.md)——一份覆盖全部特性的验证文档。 ## 🧠 工作原理 不扫描页面 DOM、不开独立窗口，而是注册 DSH 文档预览的**官方扩展插槽**，以更高优先级接管官方 Markdown 渲染键： ```mermaid flowchart LR A[打开 .md 文件] --> B[DSH 原生文件预览] B --> C{document slot} C -->|Markdown Studio 接管| D[本插件渲染器] C -->|其他类型保持官方| E[PDF / 图片 / Excel / 代码] D --> F[markdown-it + GFM] D --> G[Mermaid 图表] D --> H[KaTeX 公式] F --> I[DOMPurify 净化] G --> I I --> O[右侧标签页渲染] ``` - 文件读取、分页、刷新、生命周期仍由 DSH 管理——插件只负责"画" - 通过实时 Inspect 验证插槽注册：本插件 `active: true`，官方 Markdown 渲染器自动让位 ## ✅ 质量保障 `node test/browser.mjs` 加载与发布完全一致的 bundle，在真实 Chromium 中断网验证（**零网络请求、零页面异常** 断言）： | 验证项 | | |---|---| | Mermaid 四类图渲染 + 节点文字可见 | ✅ | | 含括号标签自动修复 | ✅ | | GFM 表格 / 任务列表 / 脚注 | ✅ | | 行内 + 块级 KaTeX | ✅ | | 代码高亮 | ✅ | | 图形/源码切换、全屏、SVG 下载 | ✅ | | 深浅主题重绘 | ✅ | | 非法图表隔离（一图坏不拖累整页） | ✅ | | XSS 净化（脚本不执行） | ✅ | | 快速切换文件无陈旧渲染 | ✅ | | 卸载清理 | ✅ | ## ⚠️ 兼容性 - 适配 **DSH `0.2.0-rc.2`**（`engines.dsh: >=0.2.0-rc.2 <0.3.0-0`）；其他版本未验证，升级 DSH 后如插槽 API 变更请提 issue - 文档上限 200 万字符；单图 5 万字符 / 2000 行 / 2000 边 - Mermaid 输出经净化：图表内的交互点击、外部图片引用会被禁用 ## 🛠️ 从源码构建 ```sh pnpm install --ignore-scripts node scripts/build.mjs # 产出 lib/（含字体与三方授权清单） node test/browser.mjs # 真实浏览器测试 node test/screenshots.mjs # 重新生成文档截图 pnpm pack # 打包 dsh-md-studio-x.y.z.tgz ``` 构建产物 `lib/client.js` 为 DSH ModuleLoader 工厂格式，仅依赖宿主 React，其余依赖全部打包。 ## 🗺️ Roadmap - [x] 对话内 Mermaid 渲染（v1.2 已实现；与 [dsh-mermaid](https://github.com/MrmoLabs/dsh-mermaid) 插件共存安全，互不双渲染） - [ ] 图表导出 PNG - [ ] 目录（TOC）侧栏 - [ ] 设置页（字号、图表方向） ## 🙏 致谢 - [dsh-mermaid](https://github.com/MrmoLabs/dsh-mermaid)（MrmoLabs）与 [dsh-artifact-preview](https://github.com/nirvanaslash/dsh-artifact-preview)（nirvanaslash）——1.0 版的整合来源，1.1 的交互设计参考 - 渲染库：[Mermaid](https://mermaid.js.org/) · [markdown-it](https://github.com/markdown-it/markdown-it) · [DOMPurify](https://github.com/cure53/DOMPurify) · [highlight.js](https://highlightjs.org/) · [KaTeX](https://katex.org/)，完整授权见 [THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md](THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md) ## ⭐ 支持项目 如果这个插件帮你省掉了"改文档语法"和"切窗口看图"的时间，欢迎点个 Star；问题与需求请提 [Issue](https://github.com/BioAIEvolu/dsh-md-studio/issues)，PR 欢迎。 English documentation: [README.en.md](README.en.md) ## License [MIT](LICENSE) © BioAIEvolu

plugins.description: 只读翻看 asar / zip 归档的 dsh 插件：列条目、读条目、正则搜内容（零依赖）
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-plugin-archive-reader

只读地翻看 **asar / zip** 归档内部：列条目、读单个条目、按正则搜内容。零依赖、不写盘、不联网。

> 不想看代码？读 [PLAIN.zh.md](PLAIN.zh.md)：一页纸讲清它做什么、不做什么、会碰你什么、怎么退回去。

给 DeepSeek Harness（dsh）用的 Host 插件，注册三个模型侧工具：`archive_list`、`archive_read`、`archive_grep`。

## 为什么有这个东西

读 Electron 应用的 `app.asar`（里面装着 dsh 自己的插件管理器、各种包的 README 和源码）本来要手写一段解析头部偏移的临时脚本，还要小心别把偏移算错、别把上万条条目全打进对话。这个插件把那件事变成一次工具调用：

```
archive_grep { path: "...\\app.asar", pattern: "版本兼容性与豁免" }
→ dsh/node_modules/@deepseek-ai/dsh-plugin-manager/README.zh.md:61: ### 版本兼容性与豁免
```

## 安装

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-plugin-archive-reader   # npm 安装（尚未发布时用下面的本地路径）
dsh plugin --profile web add D:\path\to\dsh-plugin-archive-reader
```

装完**完全重启 dsh**（不是刷新页面），工具即出现在会话里。

## 工具

| 工具 | 用途 | 关键参数 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `archive_list` | 列条目，支持按正则/子串过滤 | `path`、`pattern?`、`limit?`、`format?` |
| `archive_read` | 读单个条目的文本内容 | `path`、`entry`、`maxBytes?`、`format?` |
| `archive_grep` | 在所有文本条目里按正则搜内容 | `path`、`pattern`、`maxMatches?`、`maxEntryBytes?`、`format?` |

三个工具都**只读**：只打开归档读数据，从不写盘、不修改任何 profile 状态。

- `pattern` 先按不区分大小写的正则解释，解析失败（如 `x(1`）自动退回子串匹配，返回值里的 `matcherKind` 说明用了哪种。
- `archive_read` 检测到二进制内容（开头有 NUL 字节）时只报告大小并置 `binary: true`，不返回内容。
- `entry` 必须精确匹配（也接受忽略大小写的完全一致）；找不到时会列出相近候选，省一轮试错。

## 支持范围与已知限制

- 支持 `.asar`（Electron 打包格式）与 `.zip`（store / deflate）。**不支持** ZIP64、加密条目、tar/gz/7z/rar——遇到会明确报错，不做静默降级。
- zip 条目名未声明 UTF-8 时（历史 CP437 编码）按 UTF-8 尽力解码，可能有乱码。
- 截断按字节切，可能切在多字节字符中间，解码后会出现替换字符。
- `archive_grep` 逐条解压扫描，受总扫描预算约束（默认 64 MB，触顶时在 `stoppedEarly` 里说明）；对几百 MB 的归档仍会有可感知的 CPU 占用。
- 条目内容按需读取；`unpacked` 的 asar 条目从 `<归档名>.unpacked/` 目录读。

## 配置

`cordis.patch.yml` 里该行的 `config` 支持以下字段（都会被常量硬上限夹住）：

| 字段 | 默认 | 含义 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `maxEntries` | 200 | `archive_list` 默认返回条目数 |
| `hardMaxEntries` | 5000 | 单次调用可请求的条目上限 |
| `maxReadBytes` | 65536 | `archive_read` 默认返回字节数 |
| `hardMaxReadBytes` | 1048576 | 单次可请求的字节上限 |
| `maxMatches` | 50 | `archive_grep` 默认命中行数 |
| `hardMaxMatches` | 500 | 单次可请求的命中上限 |
| `maxEntryBytes` | 4 MB | `archive_grep` 跳过的单条目大小 |
| `maxScanBytes` | 64 MB | `archive_grep` 的总扫描预算 |
| `maxLineChars` | 400 | 单行匹配文本的最大长度 |
| `timeoutMs` | 30000 | 三个工具的工具级超时 |

## 依赖与安全

- **零运行时依赖**：只用 `node:fs`、`node:zlib`。没有安装脚本、没有 `postinstall`，不引入任何第三方包。
- **不联网**：全部本地解析。
- **只读**：代码里没有任何写文件调用（`fs.open(..., 'r')` 与 `fs.readFile`）。

## 兼容性

`package.json` 声明了 `peerDependencies: { "@deepseek-ai/dsh": ">=0.2.0-rc.1" }`，与 dsh 运行时不匹配时会被 Harness 的兼容性检查拒绝加载（可用 `dsh plugin allow-version` 写精确版本豁免）。插件本身不 import 任何 Harness 包，因此不依赖 dsh 安装树里的包解析。

## 怎么确认它没骗你

不用读代码也能验证：

1. **双击 `verify.bat`**（Windows）——跑完全部测试，最后一行给出"通过 / 失败"的结论；失败时写出 `verify-output.txt` 供排查。等价命令：`node scripts/verify.mjs`。
2. **问四个问题**——它改不改我的文件？联网吗？依赖谁？怎么退回去？答案：不改（只读打开）、不联网、零依赖、一条卸载命令。

（CI 也会在 Ubuntu 与 Windows、Node 20 与 22 上重跑同一套测试，工作流文件尚未启用——推送它需要带 `workflow` 权限的凭据。）

## 开发与验证

```bash
node --test test/asar.test.mjs test/zip.test.mjs test/plugin.test.mjs test/contract.test.mjs
node scripts/verify.mjs   # 同上，但用人话汇报结果，给不看代码的人用
```

覆盖范围：

- **asar 真样本**：直接读本机 121 MB 的 `app.asar`，核对条目数、按 `dsh-plugin-manager/README.zh.md` 定位并读到已知文本、忽略大小写命中、近似候选报错、`unpacked` 条目走目录读取。
- **zip**：测试内手写构造归档（store + deflate + 中文路径 + 目录条目），验证两种压缩方法、路径解码、目录条目与缺失条目报错。
- **插件契约**：用 stub ctx 加载真实入口 `apply()`，确认注册了三个工具、返回值覆盖 `output.schema.required` 的全部字段、`dispose` 能清理注册。
- **schema 方言**：三个工具的 `parameters` 与 `output.schema` 已用 Harness 自己的 `assertSupportedJsonSchema`（自 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-tools` 提取）逐一校验通过——即注册时不会因 schema 不受支持而失败。

端到端验证状态：已在真实的 Harness 会话里跑过两次工具调用——一次装的是本地链接，一次是从本仓库 GitHub 地址装来的副本（`archive_grep` 命中 `app.asar` 内已知文本；`archive_list` 按正则筛出 15 个条目）。Desktop 图形界面下的调用未实测。

## License

MIT

---

## English

`dsh-plugin-archive-reader` is a read-only DeepSeek Harness plugin that exposes three model-facing tools for peeking inside **asar** and **zip** archives: `archive_list`, `archive_read`, `archive_grep`. It is dependency-free (only `node:fs` and `node:zlib`), performs no writes and no network access, and refuses ZIP64, encrypted entries, and non-zip/asar formats instead of degrading silently.

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add D:\path\to\dsh-plugin-archive-reader
```

Restart dsh fully after installing. Run the test suite with `node --test test/asar.test.mjs test/zip.test.mjs test/plugin.test.mjs test/contract.test.mjs`, or double-click `verify.bat` for a plain-language summary. Non-programmers: see [PLAIN.zh.md](PLAIN.zh.md).

plugins.readme_text:
**English** · [中文](./README-zh.md) · [Español](./README-es.md) · [Português](./README-pt.md) · [हिन्दी](./README-hi.md)

# dsh-phocinae

**A local, non-generative decision layer for DeepSeek Harness.**

`phocinae_ask` / `phocinae_gate` tools backed by a [Phocinae-Largha-150M-v1](https://huggingface.co/Phocinae/Phocinae-Largha-150M-v1) server — yes/no judgements, single-choice picks and 2-10 scores, one forward pass each, on your own machine — plus a fail-closed approval gate that screens tool calls before they run.

This is **0.2.2**, a repair release. The 0.1.2 plugin did not activate at all on DSH 0.2.x: the harness logged one warning and the entry died. Everything below the *Fixed in 0.2.2* section is what changed and why.

```sh
dsh plugin --profile <name> add dsh-phocinae@0.2.2
```

Requires Node `^22.19` or `>=24`, and a reachable decision service (see [Running the decision service](#running-the-decision-service)).

### `npm i` alone does not install the plugin

Two separate things have to happen, and only the second one mounts the plugin:

| step | what it does |
|---|---|
| `npm i dsh-phocinae` | Puts the package in **the current directory's** `node_modules`. Useful for reading the code or importing the guard directly. It does **not** reach any DSH profile. |
| `dsh plugin --profile <name> add dsh-phocinae@0.2.2` | Adds it to **that profile's** `package.json` (`dependencies` **and** `dsh.profile.bundles`) and installs it there with pnpm. This is what makes the host mount it. |

Measured on this machine, with a throwaway `DSH_HOME`:

- `npm i dsh-phocinae` in an unrelated directory → installed there, profile `dependencies` still `{}`, profile `bundles` unchanged, **plugin absent from `dsh <profile> --dump-config`**;
- `dsh plugin --profile p add dsh-phocinae` → the profile gains both the dependency and the bundle entry, and the composed config contains the `phocinae` row with its endpoint;
- a dependency **without** the `dsh.profile.bundles` entry → installed but **not mounted**, because the bundle list is what the loader walks.

### Pin the version

`add dsh-phocinae` resolves through pnpm's supply-chain age gate
(`minimumReleaseAge`). A release younger than the gate's threshold is not
selected, so **for a while after a publish the bare name resolves to the previous
version** — and the previous version here is 0.1.2, which does not work.

Measured, minutes apart, on the same machine:

| when | command | resolved to |
|---|---|---|
| order 0.2.2 published + 2 min | `dsh plugin --profile p add dsh-phocinae` | **0.1.2** — `main: index.js`, the build that cannot activate |
| same, but `add dsh-phocinae@0.2.2` | | **0.2.2** — `./index.mjs`, skill present |
| same, bare add with `minimumReleaseAge: 0` in the profile's `pnpm-workspace.yaml` | | **0.2.2** |
| order 0.2.2 published + 150 min | `dsh plugin --profile p add dsh-phocinae` | **0.2.2** — `^0.2.2`, host boots clean |

When the gate holds a version back, the harness records the refusal in the
profile's `pnpm-workspace.yaml`:

```yaml
minimumReleaseAgeExclude:
  - dsh-phocinae@0.2.2
```

The gate is a sound default — a freshly published package is exactly what a
supply-chain attack looks like. It does mean **the version should be named**, both
to get the fixed build immediately and to make an install reproducible:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile <name> add dsh-phocinae@0.2.2
```

If a bare add does land you on 0.1.2, `dsh <profile> --dump-config` shows which
version is mounted, and re-adding with the pinned spec replaces it.

Git and local checkouts work the same way, and pin by construction:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile <name> add github:Phocinae/dsh-phocinae#v0.2.2
dsh plugin --profile <name> add /path/to/a/local/checkout
```

---

## What it contributes

| contribution | seam | what it does |
|---|---|---|
| `phocinae_ask` | `ctx.tools` | Runs a batch of typed questions against the local model. Every answer carries a calibrated confidence and an advisory `escalate` flag. |
| `phocinae_gate` | `ctx.tools` | Judges one command or action: `allow` / `ask` / `deny`, with confidence. Checks an action without running it. |
| approval gate | `tools/pre-execute` waterfall | Screens every tool call the configured patterns cover, before it executes. |
| `phocinae` skill | `ctx.skills` | Teaches the model when a local decision is the right tool, how to phrase one, and how to read the `escalate` flag. |

The model is not a chat model. It does not generate text, does not know facts, and cannot write code. It makes one structured decision per forward pass, which is exactly what a gate needs and nothing more.

---

## Fixed in 0.2.2

Every item below is reproduced by a test in `test/regressions.test.mjs`, named `D1`…`D12`.

### D1 — the plugin never activated

```
dsh: warning: 1 entry did not activate
phocinae (dsh-phocinae): Error: cannot get property "registerTool" without inject
```

`index.js` probed `typeof ctx.registerTool === 'function'` as a defensive check. A Cordis context is a proxy: reading an **undeclared** service name throws instead of returning `undefined`. `registerTool` is not a DSH service — the registry lives at `ctx.tools` — so the probe threw on the first line of the plugin body, taking the whole entry down before it could subscribe to anything.

**Fixed:** tool registration waits for the service through `ctx.inject(['tools'], …)`. No probe, no undeclared read, and if the service never appears the plugin still arms its gate.

### D2 — the tool definition was the wrong shape

The definition carried `{inputSchema, handler}`. `ToolDefinition` extends `ToolSchema`, which declares `{name, description, parameters}`, and the registry reads `definition.parameters`. Registering the old shape fails the model-facing projection:

```
dsh: UNKNOWN: tool "phocinae_ask" parameters must be lossless JSON before schema projection
```

**Fixed:** definitions now carry `parameters` and `output: {schema, render}` plus `execute`, all inside the harness's enforced JSON Schema subset (`required` as an array, `oneOf` for unions, no author-only keywords). `test/contract.test.mjs` re-implements that subset check, and the assembled-headless run registers the definitions in a real host.

### D3 — the gate read the answer from the wrong place

`data.answers` is an object keyed by question id. 0.1.2 did `Array.isArray(data.answers) ? data.answers[0] : …`, which is `undefined` for every real response.

### D4 — and therefore allowed everything, silently

The verdict test was `if (risk === true)`. With `risk` always `undefined`, that is always false, so `guard()` returned `{decision: 'allow'}` with the reason *"the model judged this low risk"* — for every command, including `rm -rf /`.

On the 53-command labelled set in `bench/`, recall on destructive commands was **0.00**.

**Fixed:** answers are read by id and shape-checked, a malformed body is a protocol error rather than a default, and the gate **fails closed** — an unreachable service, a missing confidence extension, or an unreadable body all route to a human.

### D5 — verdicts were thrown, not returned

The deny path called `next(err)`. The `tools/pre-execute` waterfall expects a `PreToolDecision` (`{kind: 'allow' | 'deny' | 'ask', reason}`); rejecting the waterfall is not a decision.

**Fixed:** `{kind: 'deny', reason}` and `{kind: 'ask', reason, displayReason}`, with `next()` called exactly once on the allow path.

### D6 — `gate.tools` defaulted to `['bash']`

The shell tool is `pwsh` on Windows, `bash` elsewhere, and MCP servers add their own names. On this machine the default matched nothing, so the gate never ran.

**Fixed:** the default is `['*']` — every tool — with exact names, `*` globs, and case-insensitive matching available.

### D7 — the escalation gate the release notes promised was not there

The model release documents an E1 gate: escalate a decision to a larger model when `answer_confidence` falls below τ. `0.1.2` contained no τ, no confidence comparison, and no escalation branch — a repository-wide search for `escalate` found only the Python server.

**Fixed:** `phocinae_ask` returns `escalate`, `escalatedIds`, `escalationReason` a

plugins.description: 焦点感知的 DeepSeek Harness 通知插件：审批/提问/方案确认/回复完成统一推送；当前对话失焦才弹、后台对话随时弹、子代理不弹
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-focus-notify

[![CI](https://github.com/sqzw-x/dsh-focus-notify/actions/workflows/ci.yml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/sqzw-x/dsh-focus-notify/actions/workflows/ci.yml)

[English](README.en.md) | 中文

给 DeepSeek Harness 的通知插件：**审批、提问、方案确认、回复完成，统一当成一种提醒推送**。规则只有三条。

## 规则

1. **看会话分**：当前会话只在窗口失去焦点时弹；其它会话一律弹，DSH 就在前台也弹。
2. **看事件分**：轮次结束（回复完成）和等你操作（审批 / 方案确认 / 提问）都会弹。
3. **回到会话就收掉**：你聚焦到某个会话时，它的通知自动消失 —— 点通知进去、切回窗口、手动切到该会话都算。

子代理会话是个例外：它既不是"当前会话"也不提醒，整个不参与（`ignoreSubagent`，可以关）。

### 为什么不用「页面可见」判断

macOS 上窗口被别的应用盖住时，`document.hidden` 仍然是 `false` —— 只有最小化 / ⌘H 才会变成 `true`。按「页面可见就不提醒」实现的插件，会把"DSH 被 Edge/QQ 盖住"误判成"用户正看着它"，于是你人在别的应用里时，提问和审批的通知被直接丢掉。

这个插件用的是 `document.hasFocus()`：**窗口没有键盘焦点就算你不在**。当前会话因此只在你真正盯着它时保持安静；反过来，收通知也要手里有焦点才算数 —— 失焦时切会话不会顺手消掉通知，人可能还在别的应用里。

## 测试状态

**只在 DSH Desktop 上实测过。Web 版能不能正常工作未知**（代码里按浏览器语义写了 `window.focus()` 之类的分支，但没人验证过）。

## 安装

### 插件管理器

在「设置 → 插件」里安装本包的目录，启用后重启 DSH Desktop。

### 命令行

```sh
# 从 GitHub 安装
dsh plugin --profile desktop add github:sqzw-x/dsh-focus-notify
```

从本地目录安装（开发时）：

```sh
dsh plugin --profile desktop add file:/absolute/path/to/dsh-focus-notify
```

npm 包发布后，可以改用 `dsh plugin --profile desktop add dsh-focus-notify`。

装完**重启 DSH Desktop**：客户端 bundle 在页面加载时读取。停用而不卸载：在 profile 的 `cordis.patch.yml` 里写

```yaml
- id: dsh-focus-notify
  disabled: true
```

## 配置

默认值就能用。想改的话，在页面的控制台里：

```js
__dshFocusNotify.configure({ sound: true })   // 打开提示音
__dshFocusNotify.configure({ enabled: false }) // 暂时全关
__dshFocusNotify.debug()                       // 当前会话、未送达的等待、计数器、权限、焦点、走哪条导航
__dshFocusNotify.test()                        // 绕过规则立刻发一条，验证通道
__dshFocusNotify.open('session-id')            // 按 id 切会话（缺省切当前会话），验证点击路径
```

`debug()` 里两个字段专门用来查"点了没反应"：

- `navigation` — 点击时会用哪个服务切会话：`uiWorkspace.openSession` / `sessions.open` / `none`。
- `counters.failed` — 导航调用抛错的次数；失败同时会往控制台打一条 `[dsh-focus-notify] …` 警告。

每发出一条通知，插件还会在 `window` 上派发一个 `dsh-focus-notify:alert` 事件（`event.detail` 就是那条 alert：`kind` / `sessionId` / `title` / `body` / `tag`），想接自己的提醒方式（闪任务栏、换个声音、记日志）从这里挂即可。

| 字段 | 默认 | 说明 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `enabled` | `true` | 总开关；关掉后仍然跟踪状态，只是不发通知 |
| `ignoreSubagent` | `true` | 子代理会话不提醒 |
| `language` | `'auto'` | 文案语言：跟随 DSH 界面语言，也可固定 `'zh'` / `'en'` |
| `sound` | `false` | 通知之外再响一声（WebAudio，需要页面有过交互） |

配置存在 `localStorage` 的 `dshFocusNotify.config`。

## 它怎么工作

两个只读数据源，都是宿主已经发布好的 store：

- `uiSession.sessionStatus` — `Map<sessionId, { running, pendingInteraction, completionUnread }>`
- `sessions.list` — 会话行（标题、`origin: 'subagent'`、`retainedBy.mainView`）

由它们派生出两类事件，对应上面第 2 条规则：

- **等你操作**：某个会话出现了 `pendingInteraction`（审批 / 方案确认 / 提问）。按请求 `key` 去重，同一个请求只提醒一次。
- **回复完成**：某个会话的 `running` 从 `true` 落到 `false`，且没有紧接着的等待（停下来等你输入算"等你操作"，不算"完成"）。

规则判定集中在 `src/engine.ts` 的 `allows()` 里，全部是纯逻辑、不碰 DOM，因此可以脱离浏览器单测。点击通知会唤起窗口（桌面端走 `dsh://open` 深链，浏览器端 `window.focus()`）并切到对应的会话 —— 切会话调的是宿主的 `uiWorkspace.openSession`（老宿主上是 `sessions.open`），调用前绑好实例，失败会记进 `counters.failed` 并告警，不再像 0.2.0 那样被静默吞掉。手动回去的路子（窗口重新获得焦点、手动切会话）和它走同一个收尾：关掉该会话的通知。没回去过的通知不会自己消失，展示时长仍由系统样式决定。

## 已知限制

- **Web 版未验证**：只在 DSH Desktop 上实测过，浏览器里的行为（抬窗、通知权限流程）没人验证。
- 切会话依赖宿主的导航服务：`debug().navigation` 显示 `none` 就说明这个宿主既没有 `uiWorkspace.openSession` 也没有 `sessions.open`，点击只能抬窗。
- 只在 DSH Web / DSH Desktop 的页面里工作；`dsh-app://` 页面注册不了 Service Worker，所以没有通知上的按钮（本插件也不需要）。
- "屏幕上的那个对话"由 `retainedBy.mainView` 推导；宿主没有这一信息时，所有会话都按"非当前"处理（也就是都会提醒）。
- 通知的展示样式由系统决定（macOS：系统设置 → 通知 → DeepSeek Harness）。
- 权限被拒绝时不发通知，`__dshFocusNotify.debug().permission` 会显示 `denied`。
- **完成判定用 `running` 边沿，不用 SDK 的 `completionUnread`**：后者是侧栏的未读圆点，上游在主视图持有该会话时、以及 `running` 一旦为真时就清掉它 —— 拿它当"回复完成"的信号会让后台会话的完成提醒静默消失。代价是"客户端还没看到 `running === true` 就完成的回复"不提醒（例如回复恰好横跨一次页面重载）。
- `package.json` 的 `dsh.compatibility.dshReleases` 只是**信息性声明**：DSH 0.2.0-rc.2 里没有代码读它，真正的兼容闸门是 `peerDependencies` 里的 `@deepseek-ai/dsh*`（本包声明的 `@deepseek-ai/cordis` 不在被检查的前缀里，因此是惰性的，与上游 `dsh-client-ui-session` 等包一致）。

## 开发

需要 Node 22.18+（构建工具链的要求：tsdown `^22.18.0 || ^24.11.0 || >=26.0.0`，CI 跑 22/24；产物本身只跑在浏览器里，与 Node 版本无关）。

```sh
npm install
npm run build      # tsdown → lib/{index,client,engine}.js
npm run typecheck  # tsc --noEmit
npm test           # 构建 + node --test
```

`lib/client.js` 是浏览器产物，包在 `window.__ModuleLoader__.load({ id, factory })` 里（与官方 `ui-*` bundle 同形），包装由 `tsdown.config.ts` 的 banner/footer 生成。测试分四层：`test/engine.test.mjs` 打规则表，`test/client.test.mjs` 把构建产物放进 vm、按真实宿主的样子造服务实例来加载，`test/host.test.mjs` 把同一个产物当真正的 cordis 插件挂在真 `Context` 上跑，`test/manifest.test.mjs` 盯清单与产物契约。上面说的"只在 Desktop 实测过"指的是真实使用，不是这些测试覆盖了什么。

## 发布

发布走 npm **Trusted Publishing**（OIDC），CI 不需要长期 `NPM_TOKEN`。

1. **首次发布**：npm 上还没有 `dsh-focus-notify`，先本地 `npm login` 后执行 `npm publish --access public`（或临时用一次性 token 在 CI 发），创建包并确定归属。
2. 在 npmjs.com 打开该包 → **Settings → Trusted publishing**，添加 GitHub Actions：
   - Organization or user: `sqzw-x`
   - Repository: `dsh-focus-notify`
   - Workflow filename: `publish.yml`
   - Allowed actions: 勾选 **npm publish**（`npm stage publish` 默认允许）
3. 之后打 `v*` 标签即可由 `.github/workflows/publish.yml` 经 OIDC 发布；标签版本须与 `package.json` 一致。新配置要在 **2 天内完成一次成功发布**，否则过期；若 0.3.0 已手动发过，先 `npm version patch` 到 0.3.1 再打标签（`npm version` 会通过 `version` 脚本同步 `src/version.ts`）。
4. 验证通过后删掉 `NPM_TOKEN`，并在包的 Publishing access 里选 “Require two-factor authentication and disallow tokens”。

```sh
# 首版已手动发布过时：升到下一个版本并用 CI 验证 trusted publisher
npm version patch && git push --follow-tags

# 之后的版本
git tag "v$(node -pe 'require("./package.json").version')" && git push origin --tags
```

plugins.description: Push-to-talk dictation for DeepSeek Harness: hold a single key in the composer, speak, release — the transcript lands in your draft.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-voice-ptt

English | [中文](README.zh-CN.md)

Push-to-talk dictation for [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness): **hold a single key in the composer, speak, release** — the transcript is inserted into your draft.

No chord to memorise. Hold **F2**, release, done.

---

## What it does

1. Put the cursor in the composer. While it is focused and the draft is empty, a faint hint appears in the toolbar: `Hold F2 to dictate`.
2. **Hold F2** — recording starts and the hint becomes `Recording — release F2 to finish`.
3. **Release** — the audio is transcribed and the text lands at the caret in your draft.

While dictating:

- Press `Esc`, or press any other key (say, the letter you meant to type), to cancel and discard the recording.
- Losing window focus, or switching the tab away, cancels the recording rather than capturing unrelated audio.
- Exceeding the recognizer's limit stops the recording automatically and transcribes what it got.

## Changing the key

The hint **is a button**. Click it to expand the candidate keys, click one, and it applies immediately and is remembered (in `localStorage`).

| Key | Notes |
| --- | --- |
| **F2** (default) | Function key: types no character, minimal conflicts |
| F4 | Function key, further right |
| Insert | Right hand on full-size keyboards; absent on many laptops |
| Right Ctrl | Comfortable for the right pinky |
| Right Shift | Right pinky; on Windows, five taps can trigger Sticky Keys |

Modifier keys work properly: the plugin knows the hold key *is* a modifier, so it does not mistake it for a chord and pass the event through.

The hint, the status line, and these key names follow your DSH language (`en` / `zh`).

To offer a different key, edit `KEY_OPTIONS` at the top of `lib/client.js` (a `{code, labelKey}` array, `code` spelled as `KeyboardEvent.code`, `labelKey` naming an entry in the zh / en dictionaries at the top of the same file).

## Install

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-voice-ptt
```

The package declares `dsh.bundle.patch`, so the command appends it to the profile's bundle stack and mounts it — no hand-editing of `cordis.patch.yml`. From a Git checkout, pin the revision:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add 'github:eicon-xyz/dsh-voice-ptt#<commit>'
```

Requires the speech recognizer. Install and enable `@deepseek-ai/dsh-experimental-voice-input-bundle` and prepare a model once (roughly 230 MB). If the recognizer is not ready, holding the key reports a visible reason in the status line instead of failing silently.

### Development

```sh
# mount the checkout directly instead of installing
ln -sfn "$PWD" "$DSH_HOME/profiles/web/node_modules/dsh-voice-ptt"
# then add to the profile's own cordis.patch.yml:
#   - insert:
#       - id: dsh-voice-ptt
#         name: 'dsh-voice-ptt'
```

Remove that manual mount line before switching to the bundle channel, or the row is mounted twice.

## Why a single key needs its own keyboard handling

The official shortcut service (`@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-shortcuts`) dispatches **`keydown` only** — there is no `keyup` event to end a hold. It also rejects modifier-free bindings (`bindingIssue` returns `modifier-required`) and, on the web, restricts chords to a platform allow-list.

So "hold one key and talk" cannot be expressed as a shortcut command. This plugin owns the keyboard instead: document-level `keydown` starts, `keyup` finishes. The trade-off is that it cannot appear in **Settings → Shortcuts**, which is why the key picker lives in the composer.

### Keeping a single key from becoming a second modifier

| Situation | Behaviour |
| --- | --- |
| Focus is not in a composer | Does not start recording |
| Any other key pressed while recording | Cancels the take; that key works normally (hold Right Ctrl, press A → `Ctrl+A` still applies) |
| A dialog or menu is open | Yields the key |
| Modified press (`Ctrl+F2`, `Alt+F2`, …) | Not intercepted at all |
| Focus is in a terminal | Not intercepted (xterm needs function keys) |

## How it works

- **Draft insertion** uses the session-scoped `inputActions` (`captureInsertion` + `insertText`). The plugin registers a resident entry in `conversation.input.left` to record each session's actions; that same entry renders the status line, the focus hint, and the key picker.
- **Recording** uses `MediaRecorder` and resamples through `OfflineAudioContext` to 16 kHz mono PCM16 WAV — the same format the official voice-input plugin sends — then calls the host's `speech.transcribe`.
- **The host half is deliberately empty.** Every behaviour lives in the browser half, reached through `dsh.client`.

## Files

| Path | Purpose |
| --- | --- |
| `lib/client.js` | Browser half: keys, recording, transcription, status line, key picker |
| `lib/index.js` | Host half (intentionally empty, so the bundle row is mountable) |
| `cordis.patch.yml` | `dsh.bundle.patch` layer the installer merges |
| `test/` | Headless-Chrome end-to-end tests |

## Tests

They drive a real browser against a running DSH web profile, with Chrome's fake microphone fed the bundled fixture:

```sh
npm install                       # provides ws
export PTT_TOKEN=<token from the dsh web URL>
node test/e2e.cjs                 # hold → release → transcript inserted
node test/picker.cjs              # picker opens, a new key applies and persists
node test/modifier-key.cjs        # Right Ctrl records; Ctrl+A is not hijacked
node test/nonempty-draft.cjs      # works with a non-empty draft, text is appended
node test/modal-yield.cjs         # yields while a dialog is open, works again after
```

`test/make-fixture.cjs` regenerates `test/fixtures/speech-16k.wav` from any audio Chrome can decode:

```sh
node test/make-fixture.cjs input.mp3        # needs Chrome; no ffmpeg required
```

## Limitations

- Web surface only (the desktop native keyboard bridge is not wired to this plugin).
- No streaming captions: the text appears after you release.
- Never sends automatically — the transcript goes to the draft for you to review.
- One hold key at a time, and only from the built-in candidate list unless you edit `KEY_OPTIONS`.

# dsh-peak-guard

> **梁文峰是谁？我只认识梁文谷！**
>
> 高峰计价时段，DSH 不许调模型。被拦下的那次调用**不产生任何费用**，
> 用户收到的是一句说明，以及一份「高峰期间拦下了哪些请求」的列表。

[English](README.en.md) · 中文

一个 DSH **宿主 + 客户端**插件。谷时（含周末与法定假期）什么都不做；高峰时段在
`llm/stream` 这个瀑布式事件上直接短路 —— **不调用 `next()`，所以一个字节都不会发往任何模型适配器**，
然后自己捏一段合法的分片流回去，于是那句说明就长在模型的回复位置上。

## 1. 装好之后是什么样

高峰期（默认北京时间 09:00–12:00、14:00–18:00 的工作日）你在 DSH 里发一句话，
模型的回复位置出现的是（默认**正经版**话术）：

```
⛔ 高峰时段暂停模型调用（本次未产生费用）

— 现在是 DeepSeek 高峰计价时段（北京时间 09:00–12:00、14:00–18:00），高峰单价约为谷时的 2 倍；本次调用没有产生费用。
谷时 18:00 开始（还有 3 小时 12 分），届时再发即可。
需要现在继续：`/peak off 30`（放行 30 分钟） · 查看状态：`/peak status`
```

想要最初那个彩蛋版（`现在是梁文峰时间，你马内不要了？胆子真是肥嘟嘟的`），
把配置里的 `tone` 设成 `joke`；也可以用 `message` 写任意自定义话术。
不想看下面那几行说明（只留第一句），把 `hint` 设成 `false`。

会话标题生成、上下文压缩这类「管家调用」**默认不拦** —— 拦了只会让标题变成那句说明、
让上下文压不动。真想「高峰期一个 token 都不发」，把 `blockUtilityCalls` 设成 `true`。

### 输入框那一带的两块 UI

**① 左边的盾牌开关**（插槽 `conversation.input.left`）——高峰保护总开关：

| 外观 | 含义 | 悬停提示 |
|---|---|---|
| 灰色盾牌 + 斜杠 | 开关关着 | 「点击打开：高峰时段不调用模型」 |
| 品牌色盾牌 + 对勾 | 开着，现在是谷时，待命中 | 「现在是谷时，模型调用放行；下一段高峰 09:00 开始（2 天 11 小时后）」 |
| 橙色盾牌 + 右上角橙点 | 开着，**现在正在拦** | 「现在是高峰，模型调用会被拦下；谷时 18:00 开始（还有 3 小时 12 分）」 |
| 左上角数字角标 | 被拦截列表里有 N 条（超过 99 显示 `99+`） | —— |

开关状态**落盘**（重启 DSH 后仍然记得），和 `/peak enable|disable` 是同一个状态。
宿主未就绪时它会呈现为灰色不可用态（提示「宿主半边未就绪」）—— 那说明插件代码改过但
**还没重启 DSH**，见下面 §3 的生效方式。

**② 输入框上方的「被拦截列表」卡片**（插槽 `conversation.input.dock` —— 和 DSH 那张「任务」卡同一个座位）
**只读记录 + 两个无害小动作**：高峰期间拦下了哪些请求，看得见、不动作（不排队、不重投、不打扰任何会话）。
只在有记录时出现：

```
⠿ 高峰期间有 2 条请求被拦下    这些请求没有发给模型，也没有产生费用          [ ˇ ] [ ✕ ]
  ● 把 README 里的截图换掉                                              09:52
  ⊘ 帮我看看这个报错                                                    09:41   ← 被关闭收起过的：空心环+斜杠
   ↑ ≤3 条默认展开（最新在前），>3 条默认折叠只留标题；点箭头展开/收起，点 ✕ 把没处理的收起
```

* **✕ 关闭**：卡片把「当时还没处理」的记录**交给宿主收起**（盖上「跳过」戳），并从此默认不再展示已办 ——
  于是卡片随即变空、自己消失；**之后新拦下的请求照旧会出现在卡片上**（关掉之后再勾的已办也仍留在卡上，
  直到下一次关闭）。
  想捞回来就去「拦截记录」页点一下那条的图标，它会恢复成正常待办。与折叠键共用同一套图标键样式
  （20×20、圆角、悬停底色），叉号是 **1.3px**（= DSH 自带的 `ICON_MEDIUM_STROKE`）圆头描边 SVG。
* **● → ✓ → ⊘ 三态勾选**：行首那颗图标有三种状态，**共用同一个 SVG**：
  **实心点**（正常待办）→ 点一下变**对勾**（已办，绿色，文字变淡划掉）→ 再点变回点；
  被「关闭」收起的显示为**空心圆环 + 一道斜杠**（琥珀色，含义是「关掉展示框时它还没被处理」），
  点一下**恢复成正常待办**（单向：没有手动改回跳过态的入口）。
  动画都在同一套描边里完成：圆环由同一个 `<circle>` 从实心撑开（`r` 3→3.7、`fill-opacity` 1→0、
  `stroke-opacity` 0→1，190ms `cubic-bezier(.2,.8,.2,1)`），对勾与斜杠各自用
  `stroke-dasharray` / `stroke-dashoffset`「画」出来 / 收回去（240ms / 220ms）；
  勾选是**乐观更新**（先动观感再发请求，失败回滚），点了不会有延迟感；
  `prefers-reduced-motion` 下自动关掉过渡。
* **卡片列什么**（纯函数 `cardItems(list, dismissedAtMs)`）：跳过的永不展示；已办则**按时间判** ——
  只有「**关掉那一刻之前**就已办」的才收起。所以**在卡片上勾「已办」不会让那行当场消失**，
  得再关一次卡片才会收起 —— 勾错了随时反悔。开关上那个角标数的就是「还等着处理」的条数。
* 三态都是**纯本地状态**：不影响任何拦截行为，但都会**落盘**
  （`POST /peak-guard/set` 的 `{check:{id,done}}` / `{restore:[id]}` / `{dismiss:true}`），重启后还在。

### 卡头那两枚图标键

* **两个图标键的 DOM 结构必须对称，且 SVG 要 `display:block`**：
  曾经折叠键外面多包了一层 `<span>`，而那条 span 的样式在一次 CSS 重写里被删掉 →
  inline SVG 按**文字基线**对齐，被顶高 **1.44px**（量截图才发现）。
  现在两边都是「按钮里直接装 SVG」，并有回归测试盯着。
* **整组的纵向位置由一个常量控制**：`CHEVRON_Y_SHIFT`（0.5px 一档，负值 = 上移），
  两个箭头方向共用同一段 y 区间，所以展开/收起切换时图标不会上下跳。
* **卡头三枚图标（lead / chevron / close）统一描边 `ICON_STROKE = 1.3`**（对齐 DSH 自带的
  `ICON_MEDIUM_STROKE`，官方那个 16px 关闭键就是 1.3）；列表里的对勾用 `CHECK_STROKE = 1.6` 略重一点。

### 设置 → 拦截记录（管理页）

除了输入框上方那张小卡片，插件还在 **DSH 设置**里注册了一整页「拦截记录」
（插槽 `settings.section`，注册形状照 `dsh-archived-chats`：`{id, order, label}`，
`label` 决定左侧导航文案）。页面结构对齐 DSH 自带设置页：

```
拦截记录  v1.0.0                              [ 全部标为已办 ]  [ 清空记录 ]
──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  全部 12      待办 6      已办 3      跳过 3
┌──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│ 🔍 搜索请求内容或会话 id                                              │
└──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
⊘ 帮我看看这个报错                    09:41   a1b2c3d4        [⊘]  [🗑]   ← 跳过：点一下恢复为待办
● 把 README 里的截图换掉              09:52   e5f6a7b8        [✓]  [🗑]
…（没有记录时是收件箱图标 +「暂无拦截记录」空态）
```

* **标签页**：全部 / 待办 / 已办 / **跳过**，各带实时计数；**搜索**匹配请求原文与会话 id
  （大小写不敏感），与标签页叠加生效。「待办」只算正常待办，被展示框收起过的那些归到「跳过」。
* **每行**：三态图标键（实心点 ↔ 对勾 ↔ 空心环 + 斜杠，同一套 SVG 与描边动画；**跳过态点一下
  即恢复为正常待办，单向**）、请求原文（截断）、时间、会话尾号、删除键。
  操作都是即时反馈，失败会在页面上写明错误码。
* **批量**：「全部标为已办」走 `POST /peak-guard/set` 的 `{checkAll:true}`（一条请求，不是 N 条）；
  「清空记录」是**两步确认**（第一次点变成「确认清空？」，再点才真删），避免误触。
* **一次拉全量**：`GET /peak-guard/state?limit=200`（卡片用默认 20 条，设置页要 200）；
  超过 200 条时页面顶上一行说明「只显示了最新的 200 条」。
* 这个页面只跟插件自己的两个路由打交道，**不读任何会话数据**。

> 💡 **提示：在设置里把「跳过」改回「待办」之后，对话界面那张卡片可能要等一会儿才会显示它。**
> 改动是立刻落盘的，设置页也会顺手把新状态推给两边共用的那份内存状态，所以切回对话界面
> **通常立刻就能看到**；万一那张卡片还是旧样子（比如两个窗口各开着一份），最多等 **20 秒** ——
> 卡片每 20 秒轮询一次，窗口重新获得焦点时也会立刻刷新。

> **为什么没有「一键补发 / 谷时自动补发」**：做过一版，投递链路脆弱（要跨会话 resume + 排队 +
> 串行等待，还容易和用户手上的回合并发）且语义上自相矛盾 —— 这个插件的意义是"高峰期别烧钱"，
> 而"谷时替你自动发一遍"是在你不在场时替你花钱。**已整体砍掉**，相关路由、命令、依赖
> （`sessionController`）、界面控件、配置键全部删除。插件现在只做一件事：**拦下 + 记账 + 让你看见**。
> 之前的设计推演留在 [`docs/DESIGN-replay-tradeoffs.md`](docs/DESIGN-replay-tradeoffs.md) 里当记录。

**几何是照官方那张卡片的 CSS 抄的**（`aSus8q_*` 那组规则：`width/max-width` 用
`--dsh-composer-card-max-width` 与 `--dsh-composer-*` 那套 composer 变量、`border-radius: var(--dsw-radius-lg)`、
`background: var(--dsw-specific-menu)`、`box-shadow: var(--dsw-elevation-panel)`、`__body` 内边距 `6px 12px`、
列表 `gap:8px / max-height:180px / item 行高 20px`），所以它跟输入框**同宽、同一水平中线**，
不会自己长出另一种宽度或节奏。折叠箭头是 SVG 描边图标（16px 画布 / 1.6px 描边 / 圆头圆角 `currentColor`），
不是 `^` `ˇ` 字符 —— 字符的字形和粗细随字体走，跟官方那枚对不上。

三个不写就会"看起来不对"的细节（都有测试盯着）：

* **表头那格灰色说明永远渲染**（没内容时是空元素）。它是 `flex:auto` 的弹簧 ——
  少了它，折叠箭头就会贴在标题后面，而不会靠右。
* **圆角胶囊/圆点必须 `corner-shape:round`**：DSH 全局把圆角做成了 superellipse，
  不自带这行的话角标和提示点会被渲染成方圆角（自带组件就是这么写的）。
实现上的三条自我约束（照 DSH 官方插件开发 skill 的硬规矩）：

* **不 import 任何 DSH 自带的客户端包**（连 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-primitives` 都不许），UI 全手写；
* **样式只用主题令牌** `--dsw-alias-*`，浅色/深色自动跟随 —— `test/client.test.mjs` 里有自动检查：
  CSS 里出现任何非 `--dsw-alias-` 的变量、或硬编码颜色，测试就判失败；
* 装样式 / 起定时器 / 挂监听器全在 `ctx.effect` 里（factory 阶段零副作用），随插件卸载回收；
  插槽注册失败只打日志，绝不连累输入区。两块 UI 共用**一份**轮询，不各打各的请求。

## 2. 判定口径（不是拍脑袋定的）

| 规则 | 值 |
|---|---|
| 高峰窗口 | 本地（默认 `Asia/Shanghai`）09:00–12:00、14:00–18:00，半开区间 `[start, end)` |
| 周末 | 本地周六/周日**全天谷价** |
| 法定假期 | 默认内置 2026 年中秋 + 国庆共 10 天，全天谷价（每年需更新一次） |

这套口径与 `dsh-cost-meter` 的峰谷计价**逐项一致**（那边的窗口来自 DeepSeek 控制台公告
并跟随官方页面同步）。`test/peak.test.mjs` 里有一段差分测试：从 2026-08-22T16:00Z 到
2027-03-01、每 7 分钟采一个点，逐点比对本插件的 `isPeak` 与 `dsh-cost-meter` 的
`isPeakHour`，另有 60 天、每 53 分钟一次的「下一个切换点」比对。**两边有一个点不一致，
测试就红。**

## 3. 安装

```powershell
pwsh -File install-profile.ps1            # 装进 desktop（默认）
pwsh -File install-profile.ps1 -WhatIf    # 只看要做什么，不落盘
pwsh -File install-profile.ps1 -Uninstall # 卸载
```

脚本做四件事：备份 profile 的 `package.json` → 加一条 `link:` 依赖 → 把包名追加进
`dsh.profile.bundles` → 在 profile 的 `node_modules` 下建 junction。做完会自校验
（依赖 / bundles / 链接 / 入口可达），任一项不过就以非零码退出并告诉你怎么用备份还原。

> `desktop` 是 Electron 保留 profile，命令行 `dsh plugin --profile desktop …` 会被
> 拒绝（"managed exclusively by the Electron application"），所以走脚本。

**生效方式（分两种，别混）**：

| 改了什么 | 怎么生效 |
|---|---|
| **profile 组合**（装/卸插件、`dsh.profile.bundles`、profile 的 `cordis.patch.yml`） | **就地热生效**。本机实测：脚本写完 profile 不到一秒，`include:peak-guard` 就是 `enabled + active` |
| **插件自己的代码**（`lib/*.js`、`package.json` 里的 `dsh.client`） | **必须完全退出并重开 DSH Desktop**。宿主模块是启动时 import 的，客户端产物也在启动时扫描一次（`dsh-hmr` 只 watch 配置文件，不管模块代码）—— 实测：改完代码后新增的 HTTP 路由与 `/plugins/dsh-peak-guard/client.js` 都还是 404，重启后才出现 |

## 4. 逃生门

被锁在门外还进不去，那就不是插件是牢房。所以留了这些路，任何一条都能把人捞出来：

| 逃生门 | 怎么用 | 生效范围 |
|---|---|---|
| 输入框左边那个开关 | 点一下（走 `fetch`，**不需要模型参与**） | 立刻，且落盘 |
| `/peak enable｜disable` | 等价于上面那个开关 | 立刻，且落盘 |
| `/peak off [分钟]` | 临时放行（命令走 `commands` 服务，不需要模型） | 运行时，最长到重启 |
| `/peak force` / `/peak on` | 现场强制拦 / 立刻收回 | 运行时 |
| `allowSessions` | 配置里写 session id 白名单 | 直到改配置 |
| `DSH_PEAK_GUARD=off` | 启动 DSH 前设环境变量（`0/off/false/no/disable` 都算关） | 整进程，重启前一直有效 |

`/peak` 的全部子命令：

```
/peak                     看当前峰谷状态、窗口、拦截计数、话术与被拦截列表
/peak test                不下发请求，先看看提示语长什么样（dry-run）
/peak force [分钟]        无视峰谷强制拦一段时间（默认 5 分钟）—— 用来现场验收
/peak enable|disable      高峰保护总开关（和输入框左边那个开关同一个状态，会落盘）
/peak off [分钟|forever]  临时放行（默认 30 分钟；forever = 放行到重启）
/peak on                  立刻恢复拦截（同时收回 force / off）
/peak list                列出高峰期间被拦下的请求（只是记录，插件不会替它们重投）
```

## 5. 配置

配置在 profile 的 `cordis.patch.yml`

plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-codex-bridge

Observe and steer a local **Codex** (OpenAI) session from **DeepSeek Harness**.

The plugin talks to `codex app-server` — the same protocol the Codex app itself
uses — which is what makes the live parts possible at all:

| | Reading the rollout `.jsonl` | This plugin |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Transcript | after it is written | live deltas, plus polls |
| Reasoning | only what was flushed | summary deltas as they stream |
| Rate-limit budget | not present | `account/rateLimits/read` |
| Send a message | not possible | queue (the only cross-process path) |
| Answer an approval | not possible | only for turns this bridge started |

It was built as a DSH counterpart to a Codex session running in the Codex desktop
app: read what that session is doing, hand it the next instruction, and know
exactly which parts are impossible rather than guessing.

## Tools

| Tool | What it does |
| --- | --- |
| `codex_status` | Account, plan, rate-limit budget, local processes, latest thread, pending approvals. Degrades to a readable message when Codex is not reachable instead of throwing. |
| `codex_threads` | Recent threads, optionally filtered by a search string. |
| `codex_transcript` | Items of one thread, newest first. |
| `codex_watch` | Watches a thread for N seconds and returns what streamed past, merging the live notification stream with transcript polls and labelling each event's `source`. |
| `codex_send` | `queue` (default), `turn`, or `steer`. Falls back to the queue when the desktop app holds the thread's write lock. |
| `codex_approvals` | Lists pending approval requests and answers them. |
| `codex_queue` | Shows the messages still waiting on a thread (`action=list`), and cancels one with `action=delete`. Reports what the app-server confirmed, since a live session usually consumes a queued message first. |
| `codex_budget` | Reads the rate-limit buckets and says whether Codex is out of quota, quoting the server's own flags. A high `usedPercent` is a level, not a limit, so 100% is not reported as "out of quota". |
| `codex_ask` | One question on a throwaway Codex thread, with a chosen model and effort, then hands the answer back into a development thread verbatim (`feed:false` to only read it). It is the DSH↔Codex quick-chat path; a model override that Codex declines fails the call instead of quietly asking the default model. |
| `codex_handoff` | Builds a takeover brief out of the thread's own records — the objective, the instruction quoted verbatim, what it touched, where it stopped, the quota at that moment, and what the brief cannot know. `saveTo` writes it to a file. `action: "prepare"` writes it as a **takeover** of a thread whose quota is gone; `action: "claim"` records that a person or this session has actually taken it over. |

## Board

The same projection is also a panel inside Harness: a sidebar row named **Codex**
opens a board whose columns are **Needs you** (red), **Blocked** (orange),
**Running** (green) and **Nothing observed** (grey), in that order — the four
states live in `src/task-state.js`, one rule per state.

Every judgement is made on the host, in pure functions, so the panel cannot invent
a status the protocol never reported. Each card shows the state, whether it was
`reported` or `inferred`, the reasons behind it, the evidence it rests on, the
newest recorded turn statuses as a strip, and a progress bar **only when Codex
reported a denominator** (a goal's token budget, or plan steps). With no
denominator the card shows the counts it really has and says
`no progress denominator reported` instead of drawing a bar from nothing.

Six rules keep it honest:

- A thread holding an approval this connection is responsible for is **Needs you**,
  and it is never filed under Blocked even when it also has queued messages.
- *Running* means Codex reported the turn as advancing, **or** this bridge's
  connection saw `turn/started` and has not seen it finish, **or** the rollout was
  touched seconds ago — and that last case is printed as `inferred`. The fourth
  column is **Nothing observed**, never "idle": silence from a connection-scoped
  protocol is not proof that nothing is happening.
- Every card carries a **last** line: the newest item the rollout reports that is not
  encrypted reasoning, with that item's own status printed verbatim. It reports what
  the thread last did; it is not a claim that a turn is running.
- Age is part of the judgement, not decoration, and the age is the **turn's own
  end time** (`completedAt`), never when the thread was last touched — opening a
  thread, or restarting Codex, bumps `updatedAt` and would otherwise make a
  day-old failure look new. A failed turn is **Needs you** while it is fresh; on a
  thread with no goal, a failure older than `FAILURE_ATTENTION_MS` (48 hours)
  keeps its error text as evidence and the card settles to grey. The board's first live run was three red cards whose failures
  were seconds, 3.6 days and 12.8 days old, and only the first wanted anything —
  a red column that never empties is one people stop reading. The same failure on a
  thread that still carries a goal stays red at any age, because the goal is Codex's
  own standing statement about work that is meant to be running.
- Queue, item, turn and goal inspection are sampled (a bounded number of threads per
  refresh, all of it reported in the snapshot's `probe` block), and the board says so
  rather than presenting a partial read as a total.
- The account line and the quota line come from the same predicate as
  `codex_budget`, and a reached quota is a warning that quotes the server's flag.

### When Codex runs out: prepare, then claim

A reached quota is the one failure nothing here retries — it is not a run that
stopped, it is an account that ran out, and a red card that can never change is one
people stop reading. So a quota card offers **Prepare a takeover**: the plugin writes
the handoff brief to `<project>/.codex-handoff/<threadId>-<time>.md` and the card says
so.

**A prepared brief is not a handover, and the panel keeps saying so.** The plugin
cannot push into a Harness conversation, so `claimed` may only be set by an explicit
`codex_handoff action=claim` (or the card's **Mark taken over** button). Until then
the card reads *takeover prepared, unclaimed*, with that sentence attached. The
records live in memory for the run; the file is on disk for whoever looks next.

The panel's controls are almost all reads, and exactly one of them can reach Codex.
**Refresh** re-reads the snapshot. **Takeover brief** renders the same markdown
`codex_handoff` builds, with Copy and Close buttons. **Pause this thread** /
**Resume this thread** stops the autopilot from touching that one thread. **Prepare
a takeover** and **Mark taken over** drive the local takeover store — the first only
where a card is actually asking, the second only after the first. **Evaluate one
pass** runs a single autopilot pass through the same guards, so with the autopilot
off it writes nothing.

**Keep Codex moving for 30m** is the one that arms the autopilot. While armed, and
only then, a host-side timer may queue a continuation message into a **Blocked**
thread, or into a **Needs you** thread whose failure the supervisor can read as
transient, through `thread/queue/add` — the same single write `codex_send` uses.

### What it sends

Not a bare "continue". Every automatic message is a **supervision brief** built from
that thread's own record — and only from it: the goal objective Codex was given,
Codex's own last `agentMessage` word for word (with its phase), the newest turn's
status and, when it failed, the error text Codex recorded plus how long ago that was,
the item counts for the turn, and whether a queue is still unconsumed. Nothing is
paraphrased and nothing is invented; where the record is empty the brief says so
(`这个线程没有记录目标`, `没有留下可读的回复文字`).

### Resume, do not replay

Before a supervised message is sent, the thread's working directory is read with
`git status --porcelain` (read-only, 5s, never fatal). A resume is not a re-run: if
the directory already carries uncommitted work — or the failing turn recorded file

# dsh-rtl-chat

A [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) (DSH) client plugin that makes the **conversation answer area read right-to-left (RTL)** for Arabic, with a one-click button to switch back to left-to-right (LTR).

يعرض منطقة إجابات المحادثة في DeepSeek Harness من اليمين إلى اليسار لقراءة العربية بشكل صحيح، مع زر للتبديل إلى الاتجاه العادي.

## Behavior / السلوك

- Only the message/answer scroll area of the conversation panel becomes RTL — the header, sidebar, and app chrome stay LTR.
  يُطبَّق الاتجاه على منطقة الرسائل فقط؛ الترويسة والشريط الجانبي تبقى كما هي.
- Code blocks (`pre`/`code`) inside answers stay LTR so code remains readable.
- A pill button (◄► **RTL**/**LTR**) appears in the conversation header. Clicking it toggles the direction; your choice is persisted in `localStorage` and survives reloads.
  زر دائري في ترويسة المحادثة يبدّل الاتجاه، ويُحفظ اختيارك تلقائيًا.

## How it works / آلية العمل

- Registers a toggle button into the live slot `conversation.header.leading` via `ctx.slots.inject` (client-only; no agent tool involved).
- Applies a scoped stylesheet (`[data-conversation-scroll]{direction:rtl}` + LTR guards for code) through the package-owned `styles.insert`, inserted/removed on toggle.
- Uses only `--dsw-alias-*` theme tokens; no imports from Harness client packages.

## Install / التثبيت

Requires a DSH web client (profile with `@deepseek-ai/dsh-web-app`) where the conversation slot tree is available.

1. Copy this folder anywhere on disk, e.g. `D:\plugins\dsh-rtl-chat`.
2. In a DSH agent session, ask it to install the bundle:
   ```
   plugin_manager → install_bundle → target: <absolute path to dsh-rtl-chat>
   ```
   or manually: add `"@local/dsh-rtl-chat": "link:<absolute path>"` to the profile's `package.json` dependencies **and** to `dsh.profile.bundles`, then run `pnpm install` in the profile directory.
3. Refresh the Web UI once. The button appears in the conversation header and RTL is on by default.

> Note: replacing an already-installed copy of this package requires a DSH server restart; new installs activate live.

## Files / الملفات

| File | Purpose |
| --- | --- |
| `package.json` | Bundle manifest (client half, web platform, injects into the conversation UI) |
| `cordis.patch.yml` | Loader row that inserts this bundle into a profile composition |
| `index.js` | Host half (no-op; all state lives in the client module) |
| `client.js` | Client half: toggle button, direction state, scoped RTL styles |
| `icon.svg` | Plugin icon shown in manager UIs |
| `locale/en.json`, `locale/ar.json` | Display metadata (title/description) |

## License / الرخصة

plugins.readme_text: # dsh-theme-button 给 **DeepSeek Harness** 桌面版加一个悬浮主题挂件：切换官方外观，以及设置一层自定义背景。 挂件浮在界面之上，可以拖到任何位置并记住位置。所有界面自带半透明毛玻璃效果。 ## 效果展示 | 自定义背景：关闭 | 自定义背景：纯色 | | --- | --- | | | | | 自绘取色器 | 自定义背景：图片 | | --- | --- | | | | 面板、挂件、取色板都是半透明毛玻璃，只在自定义背景开启时生效。 ## 功能 | 功能 | 说明 | | --- | --- | | 悬浮挂件 | 默认在右下角，可拖动；位置自动记住；轻点开关面板，拖动时自动收起面板 | | 官方外观 | 浅色 / 深色 / 跟随系统，写回 DSH 官方外观设置，不是插件自己的一套 | | 自定义背景 | 纯色（6 个预设 + 自绘取色器）或图片（最多 6 张），二选一 | | 背景参数 | 不透明度、模糊、亮度、饱和度，图片与纯色各有独立的不透明度 | | 适配方式 | 填充 / 适应 / 平铺 / 拉伸 | | 毛玻璃 | 挂件、面板、取色板三者一致；关闭自定义背景即恢复 DSH 原生外观 | ## 环境要求 - DeepSeek Harness 桌面版（Windows） - 无需额外依赖 ## 安装 先取得插件文件，再让 DSH 加载它。 ### 方式一：本地链接安装（推荐） 把插件文件夹放到一个**固定的位置**（装好后不要再移动），然后执行： ```powershell dsh plugin --profile desktop add link:C:\dsh-plugins\dsh-theme-button ``` ### 方式二：从发布包安装 1. 解压发布包到一个固定位置，例如 `C:\dsh-plugins\dsh-theme-button` 2. 在该目录下运行： ```powershell .\install.ps1 ``` 或者手工执行上面那条 `dsh plugin ... add link:` 命令。 ### 完成后必须重启 **请完全退出并重新启动 DSH。** 插件的宿主部分只在启动时加载，仅刷新页面不够。 ### 验证安装成功 重启后应该看到右下角出现一个调色板图标按钮。也可以访问： - `http://127.0.0.1:/dsh-theme-button/version` —— 应返回一个版本号 ## 使用方法 ### 挂件 | 操作 | 效果 | | --- | --- | | 轻点 | 打开 / 关闭设置面板 | | 按住拖动 | 移动挂件位置，鼠标变为抓手，面板自动收起；松手后位置自动保存 | | 位置 | 重开 DSH 后保持上次位置；不会超出屏幕，也不会进入窗口按钮那一行 | ### 官方外观 面板第一段是「外观」，三选一：浅色 / 深色 / 跟随系统。选择会同步到 DSH 官方外观设置，与官方设置页双向一致。 ### 自定义背景 面板第二段是「自定义背景」，总开关默认**关闭**。 打开总开关后，选择背景来源： - **纯色**：点色板里的预设，或点最右边的方块打开取色器自定义 - **图片**：点「添加图片」选图，最多 6 张；点缩略图切换，点缩略图上的 × 删除 图片放满 6 张后，「添加图片」会自动变灰禁用；删掉一张即恢复。 ### 取色器 | 操作 | 效果 | | --- | --- | | 上方方形区域 | 拖动手柄调整饱和度与明度 | | 中间彩色条 | 拖动手柄调整色相，圆环中显示当前选中的颜色 | | 底部输入框 | 手动输入颜色值，回车或点击别处即生效 | | ▴ ▾ 按钮 | 在 HEX / RGB / HSL 三种格式之间切换 | 输入时三种格式都认：即使当前显示的是 HEX，直接输入 `rgb(255, 0, 0)` 也会按 RGB 解析。 ### 参数说明 | 参数 | 范围 | 说明 | | --- | --- | --- | | 不透明度（图片） | 0–10 | 图片的显示强度，0 等于关闭整个效果 | | 不透明度（纯色） | 0–10 | 纯色独立的一份，与图片那份互不影响 | | 模糊 | 0–24px | 背景的模糊程度，默认 0 | | 亮度 | 0–10 | 5 为 100%，即不做调整 | | 饱和度 | 0–10 | 5 为 100%，即不做调整 | ### 适配方式 | 方式 | 效果 | | --- | --- | | 填充 | 铺满整个区域，超出部分裁掉（默认） | | 适应 | 完整显示整张图，可能留边 | | 平铺 | 按原尺寸重复平铺 | | 拉伸 | 拉伸到铺满，会变形 | ## 首次安装的默认值 | 项目 | 默认值 | | --- | --- | | 挂件位置 | 右下角 | | 外观 | 跟随系统 | | 自定义背景 | 关闭 | | 背景来源 | 未选择 | | 取色器颜色 | `#8FB3A5` | | 图片 | 无 | | 适配方式 | 填充 | | 不透明度 | 5 / 10 | | 模糊 | 0px | | 亮度 / 饱和度 | 5 / 10（100%） | 设置保存在本机浏览器存储中，重开 DSH 后全部沿用（面板的开 / 关状态除外）。 ## 卸载 ```powershell dsh plugin --profile desktop remove dsh-theme-button ``` 然后重启 DSH。如果还要清掉本机保存的设置，见「常见问题」最后一条。 ## 常见问题 **挂件没有出现** 确认已经**完全重启** DSH，而不是只刷新页面。再访问 `/dsh-theme-button/version` 看是否返回版本号。 **背景效果看不见** 先确认「自定义背景」总开关是打开的，且不透明度不为 0。 **侧边栏 / 某个区域没有效果** 少数情况下背景层需要界面自身发生变化才会重新计算。切换一下图片或颜色，或打开一个新会话即可恢复。 **改了插件文件没有生效** `lib/client.js`（界面部分）会自动重载，但同一版本 10 秒内最多重载 3 次，超过请手动刷新页面。`lib/index.js`（宿主部分）必须重启 DSH。 **想恢复出厂设置** 打开开发者工具，执行下面这行后刷新页面： ```js localStorage.removeItem('dsh-theme-button.state.v2') ``` ## 反馈问题 **这个项目不保证持续更新**，所以反馈的意义不是"让我去改"，而是**把问题记录下来**： 让后来遇到同样情况的人能在这里搜到答案，也让将来想接手的人知道有哪些坑。 所以无论你只是想说一句"这里好像不对"，还是发现了具体的 Bug，都欢迎告诉我： | 请提供 | 在哪看 | | --- | --- | | 你做了什么操作 | 越具体越好 | | 期望的结果 / 实际的结果 | 分别是什么 | | 插件版本 | `package.json` 里的 `version`，或访问 `/dsh-theme-button/version` | | DSH 版本 | DSH 的「关于」页 | | 截图 | 最有效，能省很多来回 | **联系方式** - **邮箱：`zhanghz1130@outlook.com`**（标题里带上 `dsh-theme-button`，方便我归档） - **GitHub Issues**：[提交 Issue](../../../issues) —— 推荐用这个，问题公开留存，别人能直接看到 **我不承诺一定会修**，但会尽量看一眼。如果问题只影响你的个别情况，也欢迎自行修改—— MIT 许可，随便改、随便发。 ## 已知限制 - 只支持 Windows 桌面版 DSH（边框预留区的处理依赖 Windows 窗口变量） - 取色器与面板都绘制在自己的浮层里，不会与 DSH 原生菜单抢占最上层：DSH 自己的菜单和对话框会盖住它们 - 图片上限 6 张，且受浏览器存储容量限制 ## 项目文件 | 文件 | 作用 | | --- | --- | | `package.json` | 插件清单 | | `cordis.patch.yml` | 让 DSH 在启动时加载本插件 | | `lib/index.js` | 宿主部分：注册路由、注入页面脚本、读写外观偏好 | | `lib/client.js` | 界面部分：挂件、面板、取色器、背景效果 | | `install.ps1` | 安装辅助脚本 | | `LICENSE` | 许可协议 | `_dev/` 是开发资料（历史备份与补丁脚本），不参与分发，可以删除。 ## 开发 ```powershell # 打包：只收集该分发的文件，输出到 dist/ .\pack.ps1 ``` 改完 `lib/client.js` 后页面会自动重载（它每 2.5 秒检查一次版本号）；改完 `lib/index.js` 需要重启 DSH。 代码里有较多注释，说明了每一处设计的取舍；遇到疑问也欢迎直接[反馈](#反馈问题)。 ## 关于这个项目 这个插件是**用 AI 辅助完成的**。我本人不是程序员，没有独立写出这些代码的技术能力， 但我投入了大量时间去提需求、试效果、找问题、反复验证，也承担了 AI 开发工具的费用。 > **项目状态**：功能已完整可用。我**不承诺持续更新**——它现在够用，我就不一定继续折腾了。 > 代码是 MIT 许可，任何人都可以自己改、自己发。 如果你觉得它好用，欢迎请我喝杯水。感谢你的支持！ ### 感谢支持 --- ## 许可 MIT，见 [LICENSE](LICENSE)。

plugins.description: Balance and per-session spend HUD for DeepSeek Harness, with budget alerts, peak-hour warnings and opt-in official price sync.
plugins.readme_text:
**English** | [简体中文](README.zh-CN.md)

# dsh-balance-hud

An always-on HUD in the bottom-right corner of the **DSH (DeepSeek Harness)** Web GUI that shows your
DeepSeek **account balance** and the **cost of the current session**.

[简体中文说明](README.zh-CN.md) · [Design notes](docs/DESIGN.md) · [设计说明](docs/DESIGN.zh-CN.md) · [LICENSE](LICENSE)

![The two states of the HUD: a collapsed corner badge and the expanded detail panel](assets/preview-en.png)

> **About these images:** they are not photographs of a live DSH window. They are renders of the
> plugin's own layout and colours, driven by its real style values and real figures — a capture tool
> for the running GUI was not available when they were made. Treat them as a faithful layout
> reference, not as evidence of a running install. Pull requests replacing them with genuine
> screenshots are welcome.

- **Account balance** — recharge balance + bonus balance, read through the same service the
  *Settings → Account & balance* page uses (`ctx.deepseekAccount.getBalance()`).
- **Two cost figures** — a token-based *estimate* from the official price table, and an *actual*
  figure accumulated from real balance decreases (external reductions excluded).
- **External balance changes, both ways** — a top-up raises the balance, and a lapsed bonus grant is
  reclaimed by the platform; money moving in or out externally never touches the spending counter.
- **Per session** — the tracker is keyed by session id; refreshing the page or switching sessions
  never damages or clobbers another session's record, because the read → modify → write round trip
  is lossless.
- **No credentials, and no outbound network unless you opt in** — the plugin never touches your API
  key. It reaches the network only after you turn price syncing on (see
  [Prices and syncing](#prices-and-syncing)); until then it makes zero external requests.
- **Two halves, one relay** — a browser half renders the HUD; a Host half exposes read-only loopback
  HTTP routes (balance, bonus signal, price sync, model list), so the browser itself never talks to
  anything but loopback.
- **Configurable, and budgeted** — a preference row in *Settings → General* sets the model, the poll
  intervals, the budgets and the warnings; the card gains a coloured edge as spending approaches a
  budget, and the panel counts down to the next peak/off-peak switch.

```bash
# Windows — double-click tools\install.cmd, or:
tools\install.cmd

# macOS / Linux:
sh tools/install.sh
```

Both launchers find Node for you — including **the runtime DSH already ships**, which is not on
`PATH`. If your machine has no Node at all, they say so and tell you what to do, instead of failing
with `node: command not found`. Install into a different profile with `--profile <dir>`, preview with
`--dry-run`, undo with `--uninstall`.

Prefer to run it yourself? The plain form assumes Node is on `PATH`:

```bash
node tools/install.mjs    # install into ~/.dsh/profiles/desktop, then restart DSH
node tools/smoke.mjs      # offline smoke suite (83 assertions), no DSH install needed
```

**Then restart DSH.** Adding a plugin changes the profile's bundle list, which is not hot-reloaded;
a page refresh alone will not pick it up.

## The HUD

```text
                                                        ┌──────────────────────────────┐
                                                        │  Balance             ¥43.42  │
                                                        │  Session est.         ¥0.59  │
                                                        └──────────────────────────────┘
```

Hovering the card expands a detail panel: balance rows (recharge / bonus / total), the three priced
components of the estimate, the actual figure, token counts, and — with parallel sessions — the
apportionment rows (`Session share`, `Other sessions`, `Tracked sessions`, `Account total`). The
panel uses 4 decimals; the card uses 2. The interface ships in **Chinese and English** and follows
DSH's language by default; the English names below are what each row means.

| Field | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| Balance | Total account balance (recharge + bonus), 2 decimals |
| Session est. | Estimate for the current session; 2 decimals on the card, 4 in the panel; `—` when the session has no token usage yet |
| Actual charged | Accumulated real spending for this session (single session; becomes `Session share` when parallel) |

Amounts below the smallest displayed unit render as `<¥0.01` on the card and `<¥0.0001` in the
panel, so real spending is never rounded down to a flat zero.

## Interaction

- **Hover** the card and the detail panel expands; move away and it closes.
- The card and the panel are separate elements with an intentional **8 px gap** between them, and the
  pointer must be able to cross that gap without the panel closing. The hover decision is attached to
  the card and the panel themselves — each has its own enter/leave handler — never to the enclosing
  positioning container. A **140 ms** pending-close timer carries the card's `mouseleave` across the
  gap so the panel's `mouseenter` cancels it.
- Leaving the **left** edge of the card *or* the **left** edge of the panel closes the panel. This is
  deliberate: the container reserves extra space above and to the sides, so hanging the close
  behaviour on the container box would keep the panel open over dead space.
- **Click** the card to fold it down to a small corner badge showing 2 cells — label and balance;
  click again to restore it.
- **Keyboard:** the card is a `role="button"` with `tabIndex=0` and toggles the fold on `Enter` and
  `Space`. The panel is a `role="dialog"`.
- The panel header carries a **Refresh** button that immediately shows a busy label and then an
  `Updated at HH:MM:SS` timestamp, plus the manual *I just topped up* button, which shows a querying
  state while it works.
- **There are deliberately no `title` attributes anywhere in the HUD.** A native browser tooltip
  appears as an opaque black box about a second after hover and covers the panel, so the summary
  lives in `aria-label` instead — asserted by the smoke suite as a regression guard.

## Settings

The plugin contributes **one preference row** — `余额与花费 HUD` — to the DSH slot
`settings.general.item`, which DSH declares as *"one preference row inside the General section — the
additive seat for a single setting that needs no page of its own"* (a whole page is
`settings.section`; the same slot carries DSH's own Language, link-opening and performance-usage
rows). Find it at **Settings → General → 余额与花费 HUD**. It does **not** take over a whole settings
page.

| Setting | Values | Default | Effect |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Model (`计价模型`) | `deepseek-flash`, `deepseek-v4-pro` | `deepseek-flash` | Price table used for the estimate and the apportionment weights |
| Price auto-sync interval (`自动同步价格`) | off / 6 h / 24 h / 3 d / 7 d | off | Auto-sync cadence for the official price table; nothing runs until you pick one (see [Prices and syncing](#prices-and-syncing)) |
| Foreground poll interval (`前台刷新间隔`) | 30 / 60 / 120 / 300 s | 60 s | Balance poll cadence while the page is visible |
| Hidden interval (`后台（页面隐藏）`) | 30 / 60 / 120 / 300 s | 300 s | Balance poll cadence while the page is hidden |
| Peak-warning lead time (`峰前提醒`) | 5 / 10 / 15 / 30 min | 10 min | How early the peak/off-peak warning appears |
| Session budget (`本会话预算（元）`) | CNY, `0` = unset | 0 | Budget for this session's estimated spend |
| Daily budget (`每日预算（元）`) | CNY, `0` = unset | 0 | Budget for the Beijing-day confirmed spend |
| Show account total row (`显示账户级合计`) | on / off | on | `Account total` row in the panel when parallel sessions exist |
| Peak warnings (`峰时提醒`) | on / off | on | The peak/off-peak warning line in the panel |
| System notification on budget breach (`预算超限发系统通知`) | on / off | off | Optional `Notification` when a budget level is first reached |

The shipped row is labelled in Chinese; the English names above are what each control means.

**Persistence.** The row writes the `localStorage` key `dsh-balance-hud:settings:v1` — deliberately
**separate** from the accounti

plugins.description: Agent 体检诊所 —— 用可复核证据诊断 Agent 使用体验问题
plugins.readme_text:
# agent-clinic · Agent 体检诊所

**装为 Skill**（一行命令，无需克隆、无需选位置、无需回答任何提问）：

```bash
curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/1687210989/agent-clinic/main/install.sh | bash
```

**装为 DSH 插件**（侧边栏 → **插件** → **添加插件**，粘贴下面这行）：

```bash
https://github.com/1687210989/agent-clinic.git
```

> 装成插件后有侧边栏「🩺 体检」入口和全页面板。**装完必须完全退出并重启 Harness**——插件只在启动时装载。

> **你的 Agent 体检诊所。** 只读扫描本地 Agent 会话，用**可逐条复核的证据**诊断真实发生的使用体验问题（token 浪费、死循环、跨会话失忆、资产闲置），并为每个问题开出可执行的处方。

[![node](https://img.shields.io/badge/node-%3E%3D22.15-blue)]()
[![license](https://img.shields.io/badge/license-MIT-green)]()
[![smoke](https://img.shields.io/badge/smoke-345%2F345-brightgreen)]()
[![CI](https://github.com/1687210989/agent-clinic/actions/workflows/ci.yml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/1687210989/agent-clinic/actions/workflows/ci.yml)

> `smoke N/N` 是**本地自检的通过数**（由 smoke 自己在跑完后核对，数字对不上就以退出码 1 结束）——
> 想知道 CI 此刻是红是绿，看旁边那枚 **CI** 徽章（它就是 GitHub Actions 的实况，改不了）。

---

## 它解决什么问题

大多数 Agent 使用分析工具只给你一堆统计数字，你看完也不知道该干什么。

agent-clinic 的做法不同：**它给证据，也给处方。**

- 不只说"你有死循环"，而是说"10 月 8 日这个会话，`list_agents` 用同样的参数失败了 4 次，在 `session.v4.jsonl.zstd#L101-L108`"——一条命令你就能自己复核。
- 不只给建议，而是给**可执行的动作**：能整段粘进 profile 的 YAML 片段、斜杠命令、已核实插件的安装入口，或明确说没有插件能解。
- **读你的真实配置**再开口：处方会说"你现在 `maxInlineTokens=12500`（随附默认，profile 未覆盖）→ 建议 6000"，而不是"建议调低一点"。当前值已经不弱于建议时，这条处方会被撤掉 —— **而且会写出来**（报告里的「已评估但未给出的处方」段会列出被撤的原因和当前值，你才能复核这个判断，不会以为"根本没有这条建议"）。
- **宁可承认做不到，也不假装有数据**：从未实现的维度一律列在报告里并写明原因。第二轮评估用原始日志证伪了旧的"数据源缺失"说法后，E3/N3/N4 从"不可实现"变成**已实现**；K1/K2 曾如实写成"隐私取舍下的方案未定"，2026-10-15 定案（写入本地加盐指纹快照）后也已实现 —— 现在报告里"尚未实现的维度"是**空的**，而这一节会保留并显示"没有"。
- **检索插件目录做针对性推荐**：按「能力标签 + 关键词」匹配你的问题，并说明**为什么推荐它**（例如"能力标签 token-saving 对上 C1；你的问题描述里出现了 token、消耗"）。目录有三个来源并逐一标出：**人工核实 / npm registry 同步 / GitHub 核实**（经 `gh-proxy.com` 中继 GitHub API，按 star 数与最近更新检索；API 不通时退回人工种子清单 + `git ls-remote`）。**已经装过的插件不再推荐**，**官方内置包单独标注**（通常已随 dsh-base 挂载）。热度（star / 下载量）如实展示，只用于同分排序、不参与对症打分。
- **面板里一切皆可折叠**：问题卡点开能看到证据与**挂在它下面的处方**；处方卡点开才展开分步操作、片段、风险与出处。
- **同类型合并**：同一指标在多个会话命中（或同一种模式出现多次）只会显示**一张卡**并标出「N 处」，展开后每一处仍保留自己的会话、结论与证据定位 —— 不重复展示，也不丢信息。

> **不做的事**：不主动推送、不代你安装、不改你的配置、不诊断代码质量、不把任何对话内容发到外部。

---

## 诊断维度

**22 项已实现**

| ID | 名称 | 判定 | 严重度 |
|---|---|---|---|
| C1 | token 消耗过快 | 会话**单位请求** output 超**其余主会话**基线 2 倍（基线逐会话排除自身；且总量 ≥2 万） | 高 |
| C2 | 上下文膨胀 | 末轮/首轮 input 增长 >10x 且 cacheRead <30% | 高 |
| C3 | 长会话疲劳 | 单会话消息数 >200 | 中 |
| C5 | 压缩可观测性 | 单会话压缩 ≥3 次，给出 **DSH 实测**释放 token（非估算） | 中 |
| C6 | 工具面成本 | 工具 schema >20000 字符（每请求重发）+ 窗口内 0 调用的工具 ≥5 个 | 中 |
| C7 | 上下文注入量 | 上下文被注入 ≥20 次且 ≥100000 字符 | 低 |
| E1 | 死循环 | 同工具 + 同参数 + 同错误，≥3 次 | 高 |
| E2 | 反复失败 | 会话工具错误率 >30% | 中 |
| E3 | 工具结果过大 | 单条工具结果 >8192 字符，会话内 ≥5 条 | 中 |
| E4 | 计划执行脱节 | 写计划后又大量调用工具，但 0 条完成 | 中 |
| E5 | 冗余重复调用 | 同工具 + 同参数 + 无错误，≥3 次 | 中 |
| N1 | 环境命令反复失败 | 命令类调用失败 ≥3 次 | 中 |
| N2 | 高风险操作 | 命令执行类工具命中 `rm -rf` / `--force` / `reset --hard` 等 | 高 |
| N3 | 权限审批摩擦 | 审批请求 ≥5 次（给出等待时长，以及**被拒 / 结果无法识别 / 无对应决定记录**三者分列） | 中 |
| N4 | API 重试频繁 | 模型请求重试 ≥3 次（给出失败码与累计退避） | 中 |
| A2 | skill 闲置 | 已装 skill 在 ≥30 天**日历窗口**内 0 次触发 | 中 |
| A3 | 高频手动序列 | **非通用工具**的两步序列 ≥5 次（去镜像、跨会话合并） | 低 |
| A4 | 子代理开销 | `delegationDepth>0` 会话 token 占比 >40% | 中 |
| A5 | 辅助 LLM 开销 | 辅助模型调用（联网检索 / 会话标题）≥20 次，给出 maxTokens 上界 | 中 |

> **C5/C6/C7/A5 是第三轮新增的"实测数据源"**（依据 `agent-clinic-待优化报告-DSH单平台.md`）：
> C1/C2 是**推断**浪费，而 DSH 自己就把**实测值**写进了日志 ——
> 压缩释放了多少 token（`shadowedTokenCount`）、工具 schema 多大、上下文注入多少、
> 辅助请求跑了几次。这四项**零隐私代价**（只记数字），
> 本机实测：压缩释放 **638,171** token、工具 schema **29,779** 字符/请求、
> 注入 **158,393** 字符、辅助调用 **96** 次。定义与阈值见 [docs/diagnostics.md](docs/diagnostics.md)。

**0 项排期中、0 项尚未实现** —— 最后两项（A1、K1/K2）都于 2026-10-15 实现：

| ID | 名称 | 判定 | 说明 |
|---|---|---|---|

plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-right-click-menu

English | [中文](README.zh.md)

Right-click support for the DSH Web GUI. Right-clicking a **file reference** reveals it
in the file manager; right-clicking a **link** opens it in the external browser;
right-clicking a **workspace project** in the left sidebar opens that directory.

## Why it is needed

The desktop shell builds its right-click menu in the Electron main process
(`lib/main.js`), and only for two cases:

```js
window.webContents.on("context-menu", (_event, { isEditable, selectionText, editFlags }) => {
  const items = [];
  if (isEditable) items.push(/* undo, redo, cut, copy, paste, select all */);
  else if (selectionText.length > 0) items.push({ role: "copy" });
  if (items.length > 0) Menu.buildFromTemplate(/* … */).popup({ window });
});
```

An empty `items` array means no menu is shown at all. So right-clicking a Markdown link,
an `@` file reference, a delivery card, or a right-Sidebar file-tree row currently does
nothing. This plugin claims those right-clicks in the page and offers the two actions the
product already knows how to perform.

## What it does

| Right-clicked element | Menu rows |
|---|---|
| HTTP(S) link — Chat/assistant Markdown, inline-code URLs | **Open in external browser** · Copy link address |
| File reference — Markdown file link, `@path` chip, delivery card, file-tree row, document path label | **Show in File Explorer** · Copy file path |
| Directory — left-sidebar workspace project, `@folder/` chip, file-tree directory row, file-tree header | **Show in File Explorer** · Copy folder path |

Labels follow the active UI language. The plugin registers a Simplified Chinese dictionary
(`在外部浏览器中打开`, `在资源管理器中打开`, `复制文件路径`, `复制文件夹路径`) beside the English one, so it
reads correctly under either locale.

Every other right-click is left exactly as it was: editable fields keep the native
undo/cut/copy menu, and a text selection keeps the native copy menu. The menu is the
shared `Menu` primitive, so ordering, keyboard navigation (arrows, Tab, Escape), focus
return, outside-click dismissal, and theme integration are the product's own.

### Screenshots

Captured in the Chinese UI; the labels follow whichever language is active.

| Link | File reference | Workspace project |
|---|---|---|
| ![Right-click menu on a link](docs/menu-link.png) | ![Right-click menu on a file reference](docs/menu-file.png) | ![Right-click menu on a project in the left sidebar](docs/menu-workspace.png) |

### How each action is carried out

- **Open in external browser** reuses the product's own external-navigation carrier:
  `window.open(url, "_blank", "noopener,noreferrer")`. The Electron main process
  intercepts `_blank` window opens and hands the URL to `shell.openExternal`, so this is
  the same path a plain Chat link click takes.
- **Open in the file manager** uses the Session Remote `session.openWorkspacePath`, and
  the request depends on what was clicked — the same split the product's own directory
  and file controls make:
  - a **directory** is opened in the file manager itself (`{ path }`, no `action`), so a
    workspace project browses to its contents rather than being highlighted inside its
    parent;
  - a **file** is revealed where it already lives (`{ path, action: "reveal" }`), because
    "open in the file manager" must not mean "launch this file's own application".

  Either way the Host re-verifies the path through the composed filesystem before asking
  the desktop, so the plugin never touches the filesystem itself and cannot escape the
  Session's access.

The second row names what the target actually is — `Copy file path` for a file and
`Copy folder path` for a directory (`复制文件路径` / `复制文件夹路径` in Chinese). Which row set a
target gets comes from the pure `menuRowsFor(target, t)`, so that wording is asserted
without a renderer.

The Session Remote resolves a relative path against the Host process directory, so the
plugin makes the path absolute first — from the left sidebar's Workspace list (the
project row carries only the Workspace id), from the file tree's own `data-files-root`,
or from the retained main-view Session's `cwd` for workspace-relative Markdown links.

## Layout

```
package.json             bundle + plugin declaration (`dsh.bundle`, `dsh.client`)
cordis.patch.yml         the one Loader row this bundle inserts
lib/index.js             host half — empty `apply`, this is a pure UI plugin
lib/client.js            browser half — the whole feature
test/detection.test.mjs  dependency-free tests
scripts/live-bundle.mjs  live check against a running Host
```

`lib/client.js` is authored directly in the module system's factory-CJS form
(`window.__ModuleLoader__.load({ id, factory })`), exactly as a built client bundle is, so
the package needs no build step. Its only module requests are `react`,
`react/jsx-runtime`, and `@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-primitives` — all three are part of
the shell's frozen platform module table.

## Development

No build step, no dependencies, no test framework:

```sh
npm test              # node test/detection.test.mjs
npm run check:live    # node scripts/live-bundle.mjs [baseUrl]
```

`npm test` loads `lib/client.js` the way the module system does (stubbed platform
modules), asserts the factory face and the slot/dictionary registrations, then *extracts
the bundle's own pure sections out of the shipped source* and exercises them against a
simulated DOM built from the markup each DSH surface really renders — so the tests cannot
drift from a copy of the code.

`npm run check:live` reproduces the Host's `artifactRevision` (`framedHash` over
`mtimeMs`/`ctimeMs`/`size`), requests the combo route
`/plugins/??<name>/client.js&rev=<rev>`, and asserts the response starts with the bytes on
disk. It defaults to `$DSH_WEB_URL` or `http://127.0.0.1:19387`; the plugin name and bundle
path come from this package's own `package.json`.

Editing `lib/client.js` needs no rebuild: the Host derives bundle revisions from file
metadata, so a saved file reaches an open page through client HMR.

## Compatibility

Built and verified against **DSH `0.2.0-rc.2`** (desktop runtime, Electron web GUI).

This is a **Web-surface** plugin. It needs the Web composition — a page to attach a
document listener to. Under the headless or SDK profiles there is no browser half at all,
so the plugin is inert rather than broken.

The plugin deliberately relies on public plugin surfaces — `ctx.slots`, `ctx.locale`, the
Session Remote `session.openWorkspacePath`, the client Workspace list, and the
`dsh-client-ui-primitives` exports `Menu`/`Toast`/icons. It has no private copy of any of
them.

Detection, however, reads markup that DSH does not publish as an API. These are the
fragile points, all in one place (`filePathOf` in `lib/client.js`) and all covered by
tests, but they can move with a DSH release. A right-click is claimed by the first signal
found walking outward from the pointer, so a nested icon or label reaches its own control:

| # | Signal | Resolves to |
|---|---|---|
| 1 | `<a href="http(s)://…">` | URL |
| 2 | `data-row-key="workspace:<id>"` — left sidebar project row | directory, from `ctx.workspaces.list` |
| 3 | `data-files-path` / `data-files-root` / `data-files-entry` — right Sidebar file tree | file or directory |
| 4 | `data-ref-chip` = `file`/`folder`, a Markdown file-link class, or a button/link tooltip naming an absolute path | file or directory |

The package also declares `@deepseek-ai/dsh*` peers for the runtime it targets, so DSH
refuses it on an unverified version rather than loading a menu that no longer matches the
DOM. If an upgrade does stop the menu appearing, `npm test` narrows it down: the failing
case names the surface, and the fix is a row in that table.

## Install

Install the package into the profile that serves the GUI. The supported route is the
plugin manager, which adds the dependency and appends the bundle to the profile's
`dsh.profile.bundles`:

```
plugin_manager install_bundle  target: <spec>
```

Or by hand, from the profile directory:

```sh
pnpm add <spec>
```

then append the name to `dsh.profile.bundles` in the profile's `package.json`.

# @deepwhale-cn/dsh-key-rotate

[![Listed on dsh-plugin.org](https://dsh-plugin.org/badges/listed.svg)](https://dsh-plugin.org/plugins/feely0208/dsh-key-rotate)


**关键词**：密钥轮换 · 密钥管理 · 证书轮换 · 证书过期 · 密钥过期 · 密码周期 · 密钥复用
**Keywords**: key rotation · secret rotation · certificate rotation · key management · cryptoperiod
**密钥轮换** —— 查密钥与证书多久没换了、有没有轮换制度、有没有跨环境复用。

## 不装它会怎样

你的 `id_rsa` 是两年前配的，一直没动。制度文档也许写了「密钥每年轮换」。

**但事实上它就是没换过。**

等保测评会问「鉴别信息多久更换一次」，客户尽调会问「密钥管理流程」——
你拿不出证据，因为**文件时间戳就摆在那里**。

## 它查什么

| 级别 | 内容 |
|---|---|
| 🔴 高 | 密钥/证书文件超过一年未更新（按 mtime）|
| 🟡 中 | 文档里找不到轮换策略 |
| 🟡 中 | 同一密钥在多个环境配置里被引用 |

## 为什么这是可判定的

```
密钥文件 mtime → 距今多少天 → 对比阈值（默认 365 天）
```

制度写在纸上，**时间戳不会说谎**。

## 安装

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add @deepwhale-cn/dsh-key-rotate
# 或纯 CLI
npx @deepwhale-cn/dsh-key-rotate
```

## 用法

```bash
dsh-key-rotate --demo          # 看检出效果
dsh-key-rotate --list-rules    # 列出规则和依据
dsh-key-rotate --html r.html
```

![dsh-key-rotate 检查报告示例](https://www.deepwhale.org.cn/plugin-assets/dsh-key-rotate/report.png)

![dsh-key-rotate 演示模式输出](https://www.deepwhale.org.cn/plugin-assets/dsh-key-rotate/demo.png)

![dsh-key-rotate 规则与依据](https://www.deepwhale.org.cn/plugin-assets/dsh-key-rotate/rules.png)

## 边界

- **年龄 ≠ 未轮换** —— 密钥可能在 KMS 里，本地只是副本。报出来需你确认。
- **不解析证书内容** —— 不校验有效期、签发者、密钥长度。
- **跨环境复用只看 .env 类文件** —— KMS / CI secrets 看不到。
- 与 [dsh-bundle-cn-skills](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-bundle-cn-skills) 分工：那个查「密钥有没有被提交」，这个查「多久没换」。

本插件是一个工具。使用者必须遵守所在地区法律法规，**对使用本项目造成的任何后果自行承担责任。**

---

## 深鲸网安守护系列（共 31 个）

> 一个插件做一件事。**安全问题是链式的** —— 配套用才完整。

**国内合规** ｜ [等保对照](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-cn-mlps) · [日志留存](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-cn-log-retention) · [备案公示](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-cn-filing) · [用户同意](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-consent-guard) · [个人信息权利](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-data-rights) · [未成年人保护](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-minor-guard) · [影响评估](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-pipia) · [数据分类分级](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-data-classify) · [算法备案](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-algorithm-filing) · [数据出境](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-cn-data-export) · [国密合规](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-cn-crypto) · [AI 内容标识](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-cn-ai-labeling)
